Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Jokes#Vader choking people|Vader choking people]] ([[Apology Accepted]]): Captain Needa lies dead on the bridge floor at Darth Vader's feet in ''The Empire Strikes Back'', after Vader answers his apology with "Apology accepted, Captain Needa" and chokes him.

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:VaderNeeda-TESB40.png VaderNeeda-TESB40.png], Wookieepedia (a promotional photograph from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980); 1280 by 1767 pixels). Reduced to 600 by 828 pixels and converted to JPEG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260209143440/https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/starwars/images/6/6c/VaderNeeda-TESB40.png/revision/latest?cb=20231111034850 Internet Archive], 9 February 2026 (the image file). SHA-256 of the uploaded file: b5d9e003e1e6713db16b055c82e1c2521d6808228884882b81e5cf63256c6eda.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single reduced-size image from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), © Lucasfilm Ltd., used only to show the scene the cards' lore refers to, beside the cards on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the scene exists.
